summary: Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, Aminosalicylate Sodium received a medium score for liver harm and a low score for heart harm [M]. A similar drug named Exifone was removed from the market in France starting in 1989 because of damage to the liver [3]. Another related drug, Sulfacarbamide, was taken off the market in Germany beginning in 1988 due to liver damage and hematological harm, which refers to problems with the blood [4].
